verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is explicitly marketed as managed cloud browser sessions with an SDK/API for launching agents (hyperbrowser-docs-1, hyperbrowser-docs-9), and community pricing chatter references concurrency levels twice that of a competitor (hyperbrowser-comm-1), implying multi-session support. However, the pack contains no first-party documentation of specific concurrency limits, quotas, or a dedicated session-management API (list/pause/terminate sessions), and probes show no public OpenAPI spec (hyperbrowser-probe-3). Missing for 10: documented concurrency limit numbers, explicit session lifecycle/management API docs, and independent benchmarking of parallel session scaling.
